gp.heading: Gross Profit
gp.text:
Gross profit for the third quarter 2026 was $380.2 million, or 26.7% of sales, compared to $255.3 million, or 22.7% of sales, for the third quarter 2025. Third quarter 2026 gross profit includes $1.2 million of start-up costs, which are excluded from Adjusted EBITDA. Third quarter 2025 gross profit includes $7.0 million of start-up and transaction-related costs.

Our gross profit was $952.9 million, or 24.8% of sales, for the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026, compared to $733.6 million, or 21.5% of sales for the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025. Year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026 gross profit includes start-up and transaction-related costs of $15.3 million and $1.1 million of restructuring-related costs, which are excluded from Adjusted EBITDA. Year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025 gross profit includes a benefit of $7.2 million related to the recognition of previously deferred employee retention tax credits, of which $4.4 million related to the HPMC segment and $2.8 million related to the AA&S segment. Year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025 gross profit also includes $17.0 million of start-up and transaction costs.

cor.text: (a) Third quarter 2026: Restructuring and other charges of $14.4 million include $2.2 million of start-up and transaction-related costs, which are primarily included within cost of sales on the consolidated statements of operations. These charges also include $0.9 million of restructuring-related impairment costs for facility rationalization activities, $8.4 million of transformation-related costs, and $2.9 million for losses on the sale of accounts receivable, which are reported in selling and administrative expenses on the consolidated statements of operations .

da_op.text: We define Adjusted EBITDA as net income, excluding net interest expense, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, and special items.

nonop.heading: Interest Expense, Net
nonop.text:
Interest expense, net decreased to $22.6 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $26.1 million in the third quarter of 2025. The decrease in interest expense, net was primarily related to the year-over-year increase in interest capitalization on strategic capital projects. Capitalized interest reduced interest expense by $3.9 million in the third quarter 2026 and $2.4 million in the third quarter 2025.

Interest expense, net decreased to $70.2 million in the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026 compared to $74.5 million in the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025. The decrease in interest expense, net was primarily due to lower rates on our outstanding debt and an increase in interest capitalization on strategic capital projects. Capitalized interest reduced interest expense by $10.1 million in the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026 and $7.6 million in the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text:
Our third quarter 2026 effective tax rate was 21.0%, which was relatively unchanged from our effective tax rate for the third quarter 2025 of 21.4%. The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 includes discrete tax benefits of $0.8 million, primarily for the release of a foreign valuation allowance, while the effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2025 includes discrete tax expense of $2.8 million, primarily related to return-to-provision adjustments for limitations of permanent benefits due to decreased taxable income.

For the year-to-date periods ended September 27, 2026 and September 28, 2025, our effective tax rates before discrete items were 20.9% and 20.8%, respectively. Our effective tax rate, including discrete items, for the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026 was 18.5%, which was lower than the 20.4% effective rate in the prior year comparative period. The year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026 includes discrete tax benefits of $13.9 million, while the effective tax rate for the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025 includes discrete tax benefits of $1.7 million. The discrete tax benefits in both periods were primarily for share-based compensation.

net.heading: Net Income
net.text:
Net income attributable to ATI was $189.8 million, or $1.37 per share, in the third quarter 2026, compared to $110.0 million, or $0.78 per share, for the third quarter 2025.

Net income attributable to ATI was $459.0 million, or $3.31 per share, in the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026, compared to $307.7 million, or $2.16 per share, in the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025.

ocf.text: Cash provided by operations was $414.6 million in the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026, a significant improvement compared to cash provided by operating activities of $298.5 million in the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025. The increase in cash provided by operations was primarily due to higher income, which was partially offset by changes in working capital balances, primarily inventory. Working capital balances, and consequently cash from operations, can fluctuate throughout any operating period based upon the timing of receipts from customers and payments to vendors.

da.text: We define Adjusted EBITDA as net income, excluding net interest expense, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, and special items.

wc.heading: Managed Working Capital
wc.text:
As part of managing the performance of our business, we focus on Managed working capital, a non-GAAP financial measure that we define as gross accounts receivable, short-term contract assets and gross inventories, excluding the effects of reserves for uncollectible accounts receivable and inventory valuation reserves, less accounts payable and short-term contract liabilities. Managed working capital is not intended to replace working capital or other GAAP financial measures or to be used as a measure of liquidity. Management believes this non-GAAP financial measure focuses on the assets and liabilities most closely attributable to our core operations, allowing Management to quantify and evaluate the asset intensity of our business. Further, Management believes this non-GAAP financial measure provides investors with additional insights into the Company’s effectiveness in balancing the need to maintain appropriate asset levels to support sales growth and operations while deploying our cash effectively.

We employ several strategies to actively manage our Managed working capital.

capex.text: Cash used in investing activities was $195.8 million in the year-to-date period ended September 27, 2026, which included $216.6 million for capital expenditures primarily for various growth projects to support the aerospace & defense markets. Cash used in investing activities was $149.0 million in the year-to-date period ended September 28, 2025, reflecting $187.9 million in capital expenditures. We expect to fund our capital expenditures with cash on hand and cash flow generated from our operations and, if needed, borrowings under the ABL facility.

lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.
